test_discord_channel_registered: test that discord is registered in the _CHANNEL_REGISTRY
test_discord_channel_capabilities: test that discord is listed in CHANNEL_CAPABILITIES with its supported features
test_discord_channel_init: test creating a DiscordChannel instance with a MessageBus and bot token config
create_discord_channel: create a DiscordChannel instance with a MessageBus and config containing a bot_token
run_message_bus: run a MessageBus to publish inbound messages and dispatch outbound messages to listeners
start_channel_service: start the ChannelService to initialize and start all enabled IM channels
